readme: Witch tuning. Edit the numbers, push, and the playable link rebuilds. Distances are metres, times seconds, angles degrees. Keys starting with _ are notes.
sections: The knobs come in sections (housekeeping, 2026-10-07): map, forest, witch, army, creatures, legends, party, view, light; each opens with a "__<name>" note. Within one, a note says what the knobs after it do.
